unit.metreOrMinute.meaning: The intentionally shared lowercase notation for a metre or a minute. Multiple valid interpretations can produce multiple answers to one expression.
unit.metreOrMinute.context: The user selected lazy resolution using inner and outer expression constraints. If several interpretations remain possible, calculate and display all valid answers: 10m / 2s gives 5m/s or the unitless 300. Independent occurrences may resolve differently. Identical-looking answers, unsupported alternatives, ordering and copy selection remain open. Do not silently choose one interpretation or return only a subset as if complete.
unit.metreOrMinute.location: Unit positions in expressions and results, including nested quantities. Detailed completion presentation, resolved-meaning feedback and persistence are still being selected.
